title: The taskbar stays usable while the AI controls the screen, and Roblox Studio through TuxBlox on Linux
summary: A quick follow-up: your taskbar works while the AI controls the screen, and Linux users can connect Roblox Studio through TuxBlox.
added: Linux: Roblox Studio through TuxBlox as well as Vinegar. PlazCode starts TuxBlox's own Studio helper directly (normal install or Flatpak), so no fake flatpak or edited menu entry is needed. When Studio is open, PlazCode uses whichever one runs it, else TuxBlox first.
Linux: the Roblox Studio card on the Apps page covers TuxBlox and Vinegar and shows the helper's own message when it cannot start.
improved: Linux: a Studio helper that stops at once is retried after a growing pause instead of every second, and a slow first start gets up to a minute.
fixed: Windows: while the AI controls the screen (glowing edges and the Stop bar at the top), the taskbar no longer disappears: it shows when you move the mouse down, appears in screenshots and works while paused.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
